title: Ankhorage Flow
summary: Provides a standalone workflow engine foundation with deterministic graph compilation and single-process execution.
purpose: Give applications a reusable workflow execution foundation with explicit persistence, security, and transport ports.
responsibilities: Compile flow definitions into executable graphs.
Execute durable workflow runs and retry work.
Expose explicit persistence, security, and outbound transport ports.
boundaries: Does not require a specific hosting topology or provider.
Does not own a user-interface workflow editor.
Does not embed concrete persistence or secret-provider implementations.
audience: Application and platform authors building workflow automation.
useCases: Compile and execute deterministic workflow graphs.
Coordinate durable workflow runs with explicit ports.

architecture.role: Headless workflow engine with explicit ports for durable execution and security.
invariants: Graph compilation and execution remain independent of concrete adapters.
Provider behavior is supplied through explicit ports.

limitations: Durability, secrets, and transport capabilities require consumer-supplied ports.
